CPU is a lower bound; the final unobserved wall interval bounds missing CPU. Monotonic inferior-wall includes debugger resume/exit handling and excludes launch.

interpretation: One combined native compiler pair regresses, one improves. Two-order medians show a modest CPU/cycle benefit with wide candidate CPU spread. Component four-pair benchmarks are stronger evidence; single canonical eval-heavy pairs remain mixed. No whole-suite speedup is claimed.
